items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Mundy took the arrangement off the -- I'm pretty sure it was off the record... And when they came to New York and did the concert at Carnegie Hall, and Martha Tilton sang it... I was singing it on second speed.

ctx.x: Or possibly on the radio show.
Could be, yeah. But anyway, Jimmy Mundy took the arrangement off the -- I'm pretty sure it was off the record.
